[SWS_DM_00934] Condition for discarding the new event
⌈
If an over-
flow situation occurred and no event memory entry for displacement was identified as
specified in [SWS_DM_00928] and [SWS_DM_00929], the DM module shall discard
the storage request for the new reported event.
⌋
